mentions.name: Daedalus
mentions.description: A structural biology viewer, editor, and CAD-style application combining functionality similar to PyMol, Coot, VMD, and GROMACs. It is open-source and ships as a standalone executable built in Rust and CUDA, including a suite of bio libraries that had to be built for Rust where mature equivalents existed only in Python.
mentions.problem: Structural biology tooling and bio libraries are mature in Python, but equivalents had to be built for Rust.
